core_idea: Media influence often reaches people indirectly. Opinion leaders pay attention to media and pass on and interpret information to others in their social circles.

How does information spread in communities?
Typical data: surveys, social network analysis, interviews.
common_mistakes: Assuming influencers are the same as opinion leaders.
Using the model without network data.
